notes.title: Tea House Simulator Big Update V2
notes.notes:
🔧 [b]Major Gameplay and Mechanics Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Achievements have been added.
[*] Added peeing mechanics.
[*] Improved shower system.
[*] Added TV turn-on feature.
[*] Reduced alcohol damage.
[*] Fixed the issue where the character would appear while sleeping.
[*] Air conditioner and stove purchase bonuses were suspended, hourly bonuses were reduced.
[*] Painting and radio purchase bonuses were suspended.
[*] Fixed issues with some achievements.
[/list]

🧍‍♂[b]Character and Environment Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed character designs.
[*] Changed character's house.
[*] Added vehicles and people to the environment.
[*] Improved human position in the shooting area.
[*] Improved balloon materials.
[/list]

🖥 ​​[b]Interface Design Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Stock Exchange interface design has been changed.
[*] In-game interface design has been changed.
[*] Conversation interface design has been changed.
[*] Escape menu interface design has been changed.
[*] Warning interface design has been changed.
[*] Settings interface design has been changed.
[*] Achievements interface design has been changed.
[*] Computer interface design has been changed.
[*] Blackjack interface design has been changed.
[*] "Game saved" notification interface has been improved.
[*] Coffeehouse name change interface has been improved.
[*] Picture adding interface design has been changed.
[*] New tutorial interfaces have been added.
[/list]

notes.title: March 7, 2025 Developments
notes.notes:
The problem of the lights not turning on at night has been solved. 
Now you can pour tea depending on the speed. 
New informative interfaces have been added.

notes.title: March 6 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Minimap has been improved. 
No more thieves on the first day. 
Reduced the player's damage take rate. 
Fixed the bug where you can't deal damage when fighting with people. 
No more financial loss for fights, alcohol and police blackouts. 
Customers and people on the street now take damage faster and more.
Reduced the amount of money paid for the electricity bill.

notes.title: March 5, 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Filling the tea is now more realistic. 
Police has been improved. 
Tutorial interfaces have been improved. 
Language optimized more.

[*] Kasada ödeme alma iyileştirildi.

notes.title: March 1, 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes:
-Game currency no longer drops below zero.
-The problem of police not showing up during inspection has been solved.
-Fixed the issue with the billing clerk not showing up during an audit.
-Fixed the issue with location bars not disappearing.
-Fixed some typos in language optimization.
-Notifications now stay for 2 seconds longer.
-Fixes have been made in the market area.
-Changed the speech interface designs.
-Fixed an issue where some UI designs were not fully visible.
